messages:
ashley: Pager triggered: gen-queue errors (US-W). tokenizer OOMs -> 5xxs for some customers. Paging @oncall. Anyone oncall?

oncall-bot: @ashley @raj assigned to oncall (priority: P1). Incident ID INC-20260317-01. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenizer-oom

raj: I’m oncall, joining bridge. Quick ask: which regions/customers are affected?

maria: Looks like ~2% of requests in US-W, mostly long-context jobs and embeddings. I see spikes starting 10m ago.

kevin: Draft for status page initial (short):
```
We are investigating increased error rates for text generation in the US-West region. Some requests are returning 5xx errors. Engineers are on the case and we will post updates every ~15 minutes.
Affected: generation and embeddings in US-West. Impact: partial failures for a subset of requests.
```

raj: Working mitigation: rolling restart of tokenizer pool + apply KV cache bypass for long contexts. ETA 30m. Will post progress.

sre-jen: Confirmed OOM pattern on tokenizer-v2 for seq>8192. Canary fallback to tokenizer-v1 reduces error rate by ~90%.

ashley: Who will publish the initial status page? We need ops-legal quick sign-off on wording.

raj: I can publish initial. Tagging @ops-legal.

ops-legal: Quick read: wording ok, avoid "outage" until resolved, keep customer remediation instructions minimal. :thumbsup:

maria: Suggested follow-up update once canary is rolled: include mitigation steps + ETA for full fix.

kevin: Resolved-template suggestion for later:
```
Resolved — Services restored in US-West. Root cause: tokenizer-v2 memory leak under long-context workloads. Mitigation: rolled back tokenizer-v2 to tokenizer-v1 and applied temporary KV-cache bypass. Next steps: rollout hotfix and increased alerting. No customer action required. Contact support for follow-ups.
```

ashley: Publish cadence agreed: initial now, update 15m, 30m, then hourly. Raj publishes initial and the first update; I'll handle resolved notice after validation. Keep internal notes in the incident doc.

raj: Publishing initial status page now. Will attach CI logs and note affected models.

oncall-bot: statuspage.posted by raj at 1712001120. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260317-01

maria: Mitigation in progress — canary fallback in US-W completed on 3 hosts, error rate dropped to baseline for those hosts.

sre-jen: Next step is hotfix build; I’ll start the build and flag when testing completes.

ops-legal: Copy OK for update and resolved when ready.

ashley: Update at 1712001135: error rate down ~75% cluster-wide. Beginning hotfix rollout to remaining hosts.

raj: posting 15m update now.

kevin: note for customer notification: include link to postmortem and expected timeline for RCA (72h).

ashley: Resolved — hotfix rolled and tokenizer-v2 rolled back. Monitoring fine. Preparing resolved status page text.

maria: Confirming: 0.3% error rate in last 10m, baseline 0.2% — acceptable.

ashley: Resolved notice posted and incident marked resolved. Thanks everyone. :tada:
